title: Upper bound on common independent set cover

statement.text: For a loopless [[wikipedia:Matroid|matroid]] <math>M=(S,r)</math>, let <math>\Delta(M)=\max_{X\subseteq S} |X|/r(X)</math>. Let <math>M_1=(S,r_1)</math> and <math>M_2=(S,r_2)</math> be two arbitrary loopless matroids on ''S''. Is it true that ''S'' can be partitioned into <math>\lceil\max\{\Delta(M_1),\Delta(M_2)\}\rceil+1</math> common independent sets?
